title: Twin of TASK-040: --apply-models prints false init epilogue
description:
Surfaced by the TASK-040 live UAT + the developer's out-of-scope flag. printFriendlyOutcome (bin/init.js) early-returns ONLY for state 'already_initialized' and (after TASK-040 fix) 'applied_workflows'. But runInit also returns 'applied_models' (line 540) and 'no_op' (line 532) for the --apply-models flag — both print their own summary line inside runInit, then fall through printFriendlyOutcome to the normal-init epilogue: '* PROJECT.md written to <path>', '* Session bundle: state/sessions/null/', 'Next step: ...'. All three lines are FALSE for an --apply-models run (no PROJECT.md written, no bundle minted, literal 'null'). Same class of false-stdout defect TASK-040 just fixed for --apply-workflows; same reason it was invisible (specs assert return value + filesystem, not stdout).

FIX: add 'applied_models' and 'no_op' to the printFriendlyOutcome early-return (their summaries are already printed inside runInit). Consider refactoring to a small set of self-summarizing states so a future apply-* flag can't reintroduce this. Rebuild dist.

REGRESSION LOCK: stdout sensor mirroring TASK-040's — spawn node dist/init.cjs --apply-models against a tmp project WITH a PROJECT.md carrying an agent_models map, assert stdout has the --apply-models summary and NOT 'PROJECT.md written' / 'state/sessions/null' / 'Next step:'. (Needs a PROJECT.md fixture since --apply-models reads it.)
acceptance_criteria: printFriendlyOutcome early-returns (prints nothing further) for states applied_models and no_op as well as already_initialized and applied_workflows; their in-runInit summary lines are the only stdout.

A stdout regression lock spawns the real dist/init.cjs --apply-models against a tmp project with a PROJECT.md agent_models map and asserts: summary line present; no 'PROJECT.md written'; no 'state/sessions/null'; no 'Next step:'. Red-green verified against the pre-fix bundle.
dist/ rebuilt byte-fresh; npm run test:changed + named init e2e specs green.
No behavioral change to the actual model application or filesystem — output-only fix.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Plan + tier: verification_tier=tests-after (output-only bug fix, behavior provable by running the binary, low edge-risk). Single IMPL phase: fix printFriendlyOutcome to early-return for applied_models + no_op (their summaries already print inside runInit), prove by running, then add the minimal stdout regression lock (spawn real dist/init.cjs --apply-models against a tmp project with a PROJECT.md agent_models map; assert the summary line present and NO 'PROJECT.md written'/'state/sessions/null'/'Next step:'). Rebuild dist (it's bundled). Scaled gate: test:changed + named init e2e specs (NOT test:all — no schema/test-infra change; the new spec is a regression lock, not shared infra). Same defect class TASK-040 just fixed for --apply-workflows.

comments.author: reviewer
comments.body: APPROVE (0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM / 0 LOW). All 4 ACs verified fresh. AC1/AC3: printFriendlyOutcome refactored to a SELF_SUMMARIZING_STATES Set containing exactly the 5 self-printing states (already_initialized, applied_workflows, applied_models, no_op, cancelled); created/forced/resumed correctly excluded and still print the normal epilogue (confirmed via init/init-command specs). AC2 non-vacuous: the lock asserts absence of the exact three false strings the old epilogue emitted (PROJECT.md written / state/sessions/null / Next step:) — each would fail pre-fix since sessionId is null for these states — plus positively asserts the summary line, so it can't pass via spawn failure; covers both applied_models (with map) and no_op (without). AC3: ran npm run build:plugin, git diff --stat dist/ EMPTY — committed bundle byte-fresh. AC4: output-only — commit touches 3 files, no applyAgentModels/filesystem mutation. Named e2e gate 58 passed/1 skip; fast tier 171/2.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSED — done on green review (clean APPROVE, 0/0/0). Linked commit: b90e766 (impl + regression lock + dist rebuild, one logical change per the same-fix-regression-check rule). The --apply-models / no_op false-stdout epilogue is fixed and locked; printFriendlyOutcome now uses a SELF_SUMMARIZING_STATES Set so a future apply-* flag can't reintroduce the defect class. Twin of TASK-040 closed. Scaled gate green (named e2e 58/1, fast 171/2); dist parity verified empty.
